name: Bacon, Lettuce, Avocado & Tomato Sandwich with Mixed Salad

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lemons
3 medium carrots
1 ½ heads romaine lettuce
3 tomatoes
1 ½ avocados

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, working in batches if necessary, add bacon and cook, turning occasionally, until crispy, 6-8 minutes. Using tongs, transfer bacon to a paper towel-lined plate.
Meanwhile, juice lemons into a large bowl; add oil, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
1 tbsp honey
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrots; add to the bowl with the dressing.

Separate lettuce leaves; set aside 1 leaf per sandwich and chop or tear remaining leaves into bite-sized pieces. Add chopped lettuce to the bowl, along with broccoli slaw, and toss to combine the salad; set aside.
Halve and pit avocados; cut crosswise while still in the skin, then scoop out with a spoon.
Spread mayo over each bread slice; layer half of the slices with lettuce, tomato, avocado, and bacon. Place remaining slices on top to close sandwiches.
To serve, divide salad and sandwiches between plates. Enjoy!
